tax.title: Tax
tax.hint: Choose once. You can change it later; old bills keep the tax they were saved with.
tax.gstOn: GST is added to every Tax Invoice (CGST+SGST or IGST). Challans can be with or without tax.
tax.gstOff: No tax is charged anywhere. Bills show item amount only, with no GST columns, HSN summary or tax split. The GSTIN is optional.

language.title: Language
language.hint: Screen language is saved in this browser. Print language is used on invoices and challans.
language.printHint: A Hindi screen can still print English bills, or the other way round.

business.title: Business
business.hint: Printed at the top of every invoice and challan.
business.stateHintGst: Decides CGST+SGST vs IGST on every bill

billing.title: Billing
billing.overIssue: When quantity is more than stock
billing.roundOff: Round off the grand total to the nearest rupee by default

bank.title: Bank & UPI
bank.hint: Shown at the bottom of invoices.
bank.upiHint: Printed as text, no QR code yet

data.title: Data
data.hint: Everything is stored in this browser only.
data.explain: Reset replaces everything, including these settings, with the sample company, 18 items, 5 parties and 3 vouchers. Clear removes items, parties, vouchers and stock history but keeps the settings above.
data.resetBody: All items, parties, vouchers, stock history and settings are replaced with the demo set. This cannot be undone.
data.clearBody: Every item, party, voucher and stock movement is permanently deleted. Your company settings are kept. This cannot be undone.
data.resetDone: Sample data restored. Your business details were replaced too.
data.clearDone: All items, parties and bills were deleted. Your settings were kept.

errors.companyName: Company name is needed on every invoice
errors.gstinNeeded: Enter your GSTIN, or switch to Non-GST business above
errors.email: Enter a valid email, like name@example.com

leave.title: Leave without saving?
leave.body: Your settings changes have not been saved.

invoiceFields.intro: Choose what shows on your printed invoices and challans. Turn off anything you do not need. Changes apply to every bill, including old ones, when printed.
invoiceFields.termsHint: Leave empty to print the standard line.
invoiceFields.termsPlaceholder: e.g. Goods once sold will not be taken back.
invoiceFields.alwaysShown: Always shown: your company name and address, GSTIN, bill number and date, item name, quantity, rate, amounts and the grand total.
